name: eigen-small
description: Router-driven, artifact-robust, goal-gated pipeline for a feature or single-phase product. Triage (small_route) picks a shape + two dials; collapsed planning (small_plan) reuses/synthesizes/skips stages; wave execution (small_build) builds each epic directly from its epic.md, gated by an executable real-boundary goal as its stop-condition, with lightweight per-wave review. Self-contained: bundles its own review agents and reference skills (no cross-plugin dependency).
